texts.how_to_play: Tap the crawling bugs to squash them. Letting too many escape ends the game. Survive until the timer hits 0 to win.
Tap LEFT/RIGHT to switch lanes. Collect paint orbs to change your color. You can pass through barriers only when your color MATCHES theirs. Mismatch = instant game over!
Defeat all d emons on each level. Tap action to attack; Tap to jump when grounded. Clear waves, enter the stairs to advance. Beat the final floor before the timer ends.
Win by defeating enough enemies before time runs out.
Move with arrows. A = Attack, S = Special. Defeat your opponent!
texts.win_title: Victory! You are the Arena Champion!

texts.how_to_play: Choose Rock, Paper, or Scissors before the countdown ends—beat the computer’s choice to win, or lose on a draw or timeout!

texts.how_to_play_desc:

text.howToPlayText:
On a grid covered with
various objects, try to form
horizontal or vertical chains
of at least three identical
ones by swapping
neighbouring objects.

texts.how_to_play: Drag the correct ingredients from the table onto the plate in the right order before time runs out. Avoid mistakes!
Use ← → to move and [Jump] to leap. Stomp enemies, collect coins, and reach the flag before time runs out!
Tap letters on the wheel to form words. Submit to fill the crossword. Wrong guesses cost time and points—play smart! Shuffle to rearrange letters, Clear to reset your attempt.
Tap a bottle, then tap another to pour. You can only pour onto the same color or into an empty bottle, and only the contiguous top segment moves. Make every non-empty bottle a single color.

events.text: The Royal Chef turned the treasury into soup! What do you do?

choices.text: Eat the soup, money is overrated.
Punish the chef! Demand your gold back.

events.text: The sheep union demands stylish hats for all sheep.

choices.text: No hats. Ban all sheep unions.

events.text: A wizard duplicated all cows by accident.

choices.text: Open a second castle just for cows.

events.text: Moat is full of jelly. Locals start swimming competitions.
A dragon ate all the royal shoes.
Your portrait painter added a moustache to all royal paintings.
Royal cats form a rock band. Noise is unbearable.

choices.text: Join the band as lead singer.

texts.how_to_play: Tap LEFT/RIGHT to snap to each side of the rope. Tap ACTION to dash through tight gaps. Avoid obstacles, collect points, and survive until the timer ends.
Move through the haunted maze. Get close to a portal and press Action to rotate runes. Match all runes to seal the portal. Seal them all before time runs out. Avoid ghosts!

texts.tapToStart:
Shoot to defend your player! Survive and score
as high as you can.

texts.how_to_play: Tap or click to shoot when the oscillating aim line points at the enemy. Defeat three enemies and then a tougher mini-boss to clear Level 1.
Drag the joystick to aim (hold to charge) and release to shoot:
Landscape. Survive for 60s. Move with ←/→, jump with ↑ or Space. Shoot with Z or Action. Pick up crates for AK/Shotgun.
Move with WASD/Arrows. Hold Space/Click/Action to shoot. Collect Vaccines for Burst (E or double-tap Action). Survive until the timer hits 0.

texts.how_to_play: Penalties: On your turn, choose Left/Center/Right and tap Action to shoot. On defense, choose a dive direction and tap Action to commit. Score more than the CPU in 5 rounds. Ties go to sudden death.
How to Play
Guess the hidden word in six tries. Each guess must be a real word. Letters turn green when correct and in the right spot, yellow when in the word but wrong spot, and gray when not in the word.
Connect letters to form valid words. Fill the crossword grid to win. Drag across letters in sequence; release to submit.
